name: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
summary: Something gleams beneath the rubble: a badge bearing Theramore's sign, a golden anchor over white enamel, with the name Lieutenant Paval Reethe embossed under the anchor. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore is the one to bring it to.

sections.title: A Glint in the Rubble
sections.body: Something gleams beneath the rubble. Brushing off the ash and debris reveals a badge showing the sign of Theramore, with Lieutenant Paval Reethe's name embossed below it. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore should see it, and will ask what turned up in the ruins of the Shady Rest Inn.

sections.title: The Captain's Reply
sections.body: Vimes says a guard's badge brought in is never good news. Some guards fall in battle, and Vimes must carry the word to their grieving families. For others, nobody ever learns what became of them, and sometimes the truth is worse still.

faq.answer: It lies beneath rubble, caked in ash and debris. Captain Garran Vimes will ask what turned up in the ruins of the Shady Rest Inn.

faq.q: Whose name is on the badge?
faq.answer: The name embossed beneath the anchor is Lieutenant Paval Reethe.

aliases: who do i give the badge to
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes, in Theramore, is who should see it.

faq.q: What does the badge look like?
aliases: what does the badge look like
faq.answer: A gold anchor over white enamel, which is the sign of Theramore.

attribution: Classic quest text: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
